hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "."'); cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; why=''; if printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]) *(git( +(-[^ ]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.]+=[^ ]*))* +push|gh +pr +create)( |$)'; then why='push / PR'; fi; if [ -z "$why" ] && printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]) *git( +(-[^ ]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.]+=[^ ]*))* +commit( |$)' && [ "$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = 'main' ]; then why='commit on main'; fi; [ -n "$why" ] || exit 0; if bun run format && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run test && bun run build; then exit 0; else echo "Gates failed before $why — format / lint / typecheck / knip / test / build must all pass." >&2; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Gates: format, lint, typecheck, knip, test, build…
